intro.en: People love Sayulita and San Pancho for their laid-back vibe, amazing food, and endless outdoor adventures.
intro.es: La gente ama Sayulita y San Pancho por su vibra relajada, comida increíble y aventuras al aire libre interminables.

picks.name: Mary's Taco Sayulita
picks.en: Visitors rave about Mary's fish and shrimp tacos and homemade horchata.
picks.es: Los visitantes adoran los tacos de pescado y camarón de Mary's y la horchata casera.

picks.name: La Lancha Beach
picks.en: La Lancha is a legit surf spot popular with learners and experienced surfers alike.
picks.es: La Lancha es un lugar legítimo para surfear popular con principiantes y surfistas experimentados.

picks.name: Don Pedro's Restaurant & Bar
picks.en: Don Pedro's upstairs offers intimate views; main floor provides casual, consistently good food.
picks.es: Don Pedro's arriba ofrece vistas íntimas; el piso principal proporciona comida casual consistentemente buena.

picks.name: Lo de Marcos
picks.en: Lo de Marcos is a walkable beach town nearby with calm, mellow atmosphere.
picks.es: Lo de Marcos es un pueblo playero cercano accesible a pie con atmósfera tranquila.

picks.name: Sayulita Sandbar
picks.en: Sayulita Sandbar offers ping pong, pickleball, cornhole, sports, karaoke and great burgers.
picks.es: Sayulita Sandbar ofrece ping pong, pádel de playa, cornhole, deportes, karaoke y excelentes hamburguesas.

picks.name: Playa Los Muertos
picks.en: Playa Los Muertos is smaller, less crowded, with gentler waves and food vendors.
picks.es: Playa Los Muertos es más pequeña, menos concurrida, con olas suaves y vendedores de comida.

picks.name: Playa Carricitos
picks.en: Playa Carricitos offers solitude and beautiful sunsets after a 20-30 minute hike.
picks.es: Playa Carricitos ofrece soledad y puestas de sol hermosas después de una caminata de 20-30 minutos.

picks.name: Public House
picks.en: Public House on the square has a reliable ATM and chill local vibe.
picks.es: Public House en la plaza tiene un cajero automático confiable y atmósfera local tranquila.

picks.name: Tacos Al Pastor Tal Ivan
picks.en: Tacos Tal Ivan in the main square serves reliable tacos with extended hours.
picks.es: Tacos Tal Ivan en la plaza principal sirve tacos confiables con horarios extendidos.

picks.name: Hotelito Los Sueños
picks.en: Hotelito Los Sueños is near the beach with breakfast buffet and yoga classes.
picks.es: Hotelito Los Sueños está cerca de la playa con bufet de desayuno y clases de yoga.

picks.name: Sur 38
picks.en: Sur 38 offers tapas and wine in an intimate, quiet, upscale setting.
picks.es: Sur 38 ofrece tapas y vino en un ambiente íntimo, tranquilo y de lujo.

picks.name: Surf It Out
picks.en: Risa at Surf It Out is highly recommended for personalized, excellent surf lessons.
picks.es: Risa en Surf It Out es altamente recomendada para lecciones de surf personalizadas y excelentes.

picks.name: Tacos Toño
picks.en: Tacos Toño's suadero melts in mouth with an excellent condiments bar.
picks.es: La carne de suadero de Tacos Toño se derrite en la boca con excelente barra de condimentos.

picks.name: Alley Cat Tours
picks.en: Alley Cat Tours offers all-inclusive snorkel trips with great food to nearby islands.
picks.es: Alley Cat Tours ofrece viajes de snorkel todo incluido con buena comida a islas cercanas.

picks.name: Alto Alto
picks.en: Alto Alto provides upscale Mediterranean dining in a fun, energetic location.
picks.es: Alto Alto proporciona comida mediterránea de lujo en una ubicación divertida y energética.

picks.name: Aaleyah's Wings
picks.en: Aaleyah's serves the best margaritas with owner's family tequila and friendly staff.
picks.es: Aaleyah's sirve las mejores margaritas con tequila de la familia del dueño y personal amable.

picks.name: Viajero Hostel
picks.en: Viajero Hostel offers nightly social events, clean rooms, good food and pool.
picks.es: Viajero Hostel ofrece eventos sociales nocturnos, habitaciones limpias, buena comida y piscina.

picks.name: Pineapple Paradise
picks.en: Pineapple Paradise offers excellent sandwiches, people watching and Wednesday karaoke nights.
picks.es: Pineapple Paradise ofrece excelentes sándwiches, observación de gente y noches de karaoke los miércoles.

picks.name: My Sister's House
picks.en: My Sister's House is an affordable women-only hostel with outside kitchen access.
picks.es: My Sister's House es un albergue solo para mujeres asequible con acceso a cocina exterior.

picks.name: Monkey Mountain
picks.en: Monkey Mountain hike offers beautiful views; hiring a guide is highly recommended.
picks.es: La caminata de Monkey Mountain ofrece vistas hermosas; se recomienda altamente contratar un guía.

picks.name: Anchor Cafe
picks.en: Anchor Cafe serves amazing coffee and vegan options, operating since 2016.
picks.es: Anchor Cafe sirve café excelente y opciones veganas, operando desde 2016.

picks.name: Northswell Cafe
picks.en: Northswell offers vegan menu with traditional Mexican dishes and excellent vegan breakfast.
picks.es: Northswell ofrece menú vegano con platos mexicanos tradicionales y excelente desayuno vegano.

picks.name: The Dock
picks.en: The Dock serves puttanesca right on the beach with good food and drinks.
picks.es: The Dock sirve puttanesca justo en la playa con buena comida y bebidas.

picks.name: Marietas Islands
picks.en: Marietas Islands offers incredible snorkeling with lunch included; currents can be strong.
picks.es: Las Islas Marietas ofrecen snorkel increíble con almuerzo incluido; las corrientes pueden ser fuertes.

picks.name: Kapital Bank
picks.en: Kapital Bank reopened with reliably working ATMs for consistent cash access.
picks.es: Kapital Bank reabrió con cajeros automáticos que funcionan confiablemente para acceso consistente a efectivo.

picks.name: El Espresso
picks.en: El Espresso offers reliable coffee and a consistently working ATM in town.
picks.es: El Espresso ofrece café confiable y un cajero automático que funciona constantemente en el centro.

picks.name: M&F Coffee Roasters
picks.en: M&F Coffee Roasters serves well-regarded medium roast coffee in a small shop.
picks.es: M&F Coffee Roasters sirve café de tostado medio bien considerado en una pequeña tienda.

picks.name: Tropical House Cafe
picks.en: Tropical House offers breakfast, sports bar atmosphere and fantastic Tuesday nights.
picks.es: Tropical House ofrece desayuno, atmósfera de bar deportivo y noches de martes fantásticas.

picks.name: The Embers
picks.en: The Embers has live music regularly, private seating and becomes a dance club.
picks.es: The Embers tiene música en vivo regularmente, asientos privados y se convierte en club de baile.

picks.name: Rincón de Guayabitos
picks.en: Rincón de Guayabitos is 20 minutes north with lower accommodation prices.
picks.es: Rincón de Guayabitos está 20 minutos al norte con precios de alojamiento más bajos.

picks.name: Choco Banana
picks.en: Choco Banana serves surprisingly good bean burgers with fresh ingredients.
picks.es: Choco Banana sirve hamburguesas de frijoles sorprendentemente buenas con ingredientes frescos.

picks.name: Matiz Mariscos
picks.en: Matiz Mariscos offers fresh seafood including atun tostada and cold micheladas.
picks.es: Matiz Mariscos ofrece mariscos frescos incluyendo tostada de atún y micheladas frías.

picks.name: Naty's Cocina
picks.en: Naty's Cocina serves delicious inexpensive vegetarian tacos during daytime hours only.
picks.es: Naty's Cocina sirve deliciosos tacos vegetarianos económicos solo durante las horas del día.

picks.name: Escondido Bar
picks.en: Escondido Bar features female house musicians and cocktails with 2-for-1 deals.
picks.es: Escondido Bar presenta músicos de la casa femenina y cócteles con ofertas de 2x1.

picks.name: Tierra Tropical Beach Club
picks.en: Tierra Tropical Beach Club offers day passes with amazing food and spacious pool.
picks.es: Tierra Tropical Beach Club ofrece pases diarios con comida amazing y piscina espaciosa.

picks.name: Marea Cafe
picks.en: Marea Cafe serves affordable food with vegan options, excellent for breakfast.
picks.es: Marea Cafe sirve comida asequible con opciones veganas, excelente para el desayuno.

picks.name: Carbon
picks.en: Carbon offers a quiet patio with cozy vibe and open kitchen, opens 8pm.
picks.es: Carbon ofrece un patio tranquilo con vibra acogedora y cocina abierta, abre a las 8pm.

picks.name: El Itacate
picks.en: El Itacate serves jamaica and vegetable tacos with amazing aguas frescas.
picks.es: El Itacate sirve tacos de jamaica y vegetales con aguas frescas deliciosas.

picks.name: Tiburón
picks.en: Tiburón offers excellent fish of the day and highly praised watermelon margaritas.
picks.es: Tiburón ofrece excelente pescado del día y margaritas de sandía altamente elogiadas.

picks.name: Julia's Jungle Kitchen
picks.en: Julia's Jungle Kitchen serves best coffee inside Nawalli's Plaza on Calle Miramar.
picks.es: Julia's Jungle Kitchen sirve el mejor café dentro de Nawalli's Plaza en Calle Miramar.

tips.en: Budget 1000-2000 pesos daily, or eat three excellent meals for US$40/day.
tips.es: Presupuesta 1000-2000 pesos diarios, o come tres comidas excelentes por US$40/día.

tips.en: Rent golf carts (500 pesos/day) or ATVs to explore surrounding areas easily.
tips.es: Renta carritos de golf (500 pesos/día) o ATVs para explorar áreas cercanas fácilmente.

tips.en: Murals cover town; Thursday market at Marina; huge Dia de los Muertos parade.
tips.es: Murales cubren pueblo; mercado jueves en Marina; enorme desfile Día de Muertos.

tips.en: San Pancho offers quieter, more laid-back alternative to busier Sayulita atmosphere.
tips.es: San Pancho ofrece alternativa más tranquila y relajada a atmósfera ocupada de Sayulita.

tips.en: Tip in pesos not USD; exchange cash before arriving for better rates.
tips.es: Propina en pesos no USD; cambia efectivo antes de llegar para mejores tasas.

tips.en: October unpredictable; November cooler and drier, best time for visiting area.
tips.es: Octubre impredecible; noviembre más fresco y seco, mejor época para visitar.

tips.en: Wear sturdy shoes for cobblestones; pack strong sunscreen for intense sun.
tips.es: Usa zapatos firmes para adoquines; empaca protector solar fuerte para sol intenso.

tips.en: Monkey Mountain hike and panga fishing available; hire guide for experience.
tips.es: Caminata Monkey Mountain y pesca panga disponible; contrata guía para mejor experiencia.
